query: Will I be paid dividends if I own shares?

cands.text: Stock basically implies your ownership in the company. If you own 1% ownership in a company, the value of your stake becomes equal to 1% of the valuation of the entire company. Dividends are basically disbursal of company's profits to its shareholders. By holding stocks of a company, you become eligible to receiving dividends proportional to your ownership in the company. Once the company pays a dividend, that cash is no longer part of the company's equity and the share price is adjusted accordingly.
